decisions.reason: As a desk system closely tied to the firm's office furniture know-how, this product fits existing design, engineering and commercial capabilities, so the firm is well placed to refine it rather than withdraw it.
A chair family is very close to the firm's established seating and interior expertise, giving management strong absorptive capacity to interpret market feedback and improve the line.

Floor cushions made from carpets are more niche, but they still build on the firm's material and interior-solution knowledge enough that the firm would likely keep them while learning from early demand.

The sofa is close to the core upholstered furniture business, but its lower website prominence suggests a somewhat weaker commitment or traction, raising the chance of review without making withdrawal most likely.

A high standing table matches the firm's move toward flexible workplace settings and can be supported by its existing office-furniture development capabilities, so it is likely to remain in the portfolio.

Because the rug collection is the most distant from the firm's established offer, management has less related knowledge to absorb feedback and improve it efficiently, making discontinuation the most likely choice.
